# 01 — Requirements Traceability Matrix

**Project:** SlotSync (Booking SaaS for Local Service Businesses)  
**Target Architecture:** Single Cloudflare Worker (React SPA static assets + Hono/REST API) + D1 SQLite + Cron Trigger + Resend  
**Source Specifications:**
- `SlotSync_Updated_Complete_Project_Blueprint.pdf` (Sections 1–16)
- `SlotSync_Master_Prompt_for_Claude_Full.pdf`
- `SlotSync — Antigravity Build Playbook.docx` (Section 4 Traceability Seed)

---

---

## Priority Distribution Summary

- **P0 (Absolute MVP / Demo Cut Line):** 28 requirements (Core booking, conflict prevention, owner operations, basic customer history, real/sandbox notifications, tenant isolation, security, mobile-first UI)
- **P1 (High Value Enhancements):** 16 requirements (Industry presets, alternative slots, needs attention panel, duplicate merge, quiet hours, reviews, distribution templates, analytics)
- **P2 (Deferred / Post-Hackathon):** 1 requirement (Waitlist automatic matching and self-service intake)
- **Total Requirements Tracked:** 45 requirements
